blocks.p: Right-click an item, or a thing in the world, to open its context menu: the actions you can take on it. Figure 25-1 shows the menu as the game draws it.

caption: Figure 25-1
The context menu as the game draws it.

blocks.p: The menu is drawn in one of two styles, the strip and the list, shown in Figure 25-2. In the strip each action is an icon, and the selected action is named above the strip. In the list each action has a row of its own, with its icon.
An action that opens a submenu has a corner mark in the strip and a *>* in the list. To choose a style, open *Options* and pick the strip or the list on the *ZeD setup* page.

blocks.note: In the strip the selected action is drawn in the accent color.

blocks.p: Figure 25-2 shows the menu for an apple in both styles. *Eat*, *Move to* and *Save to loadout* each open a submenu.

caption: Figure 25-2
The strip, top, and the list, bottom.

marks.text: Strip: each action is an icon. The selected one is named above it.
A corner mark means the action opens a submenu.
List: one action to a row, with its icon. A > means a submenu.

sticky.text: Choose the strip or the list in Options, ZeD setup.
